root_cause.text: The `port->aggregator` pointer in the bonding 802.3ad code was accessed concurrently without RCU synchronization, leading to a data-race between the write in `ad_port_selection_logic` (via the workqueue handler) and the read in `__bond_3ad_get_active_agg_info` (via netlink/sysfs paths), because the pointer was not annotated as `__rcu` and no RCU primitives were used for access.
root_cause.evidence: The KCSAN report directly shows a write to `port->aggregator` in `ad_port_selection_logic` (line 1659) and a read in `__bond_3ad_get_active_agg_info` (line 2858). The patch adds `__rcu` to the field in `include/net/bond_3ad.h` and uses `rcu_dereference`, `rcu_assign_pointer`, `rcu_access_pointer`, and `rcu_read_lock/unlock` in all access sites, confirming the missing RCU protection.
